name: Argumentative Essay (100 points)
description: A general-purpose rubric for evidence-based argumentative writing.

criteria.name: Thesis and focus
criteria.description: Presents a clear, specific, defensible claim and maintains focus.

criteria.name: Evidence and reasoning
criteria.description: Uses relevant evidence and explains how it supports the claim.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: Uses a logical structure with effective transitions.

criteria.name: Style and clarity
criteria.description: Uses precise language, an appropriate tone, and readable sentences.

criteria.name: Mechanics and formatting
criteria.description: Demonstrates control of grammar, spelling, punctuation, and required format.
